title: Love's Final Goodbye
description: She spent five years giving him her heart, only to be cast aside the second his ex walked back into his life. But the moment she signs the divorce papers and disappears without a trace, panic sets in. Will he earn back the woman he shattered, or is this truly their final goodbye?
